paper_id: Plug-and-Play Parameter-Efficient Tuning of Embeddings for Federated Recommendation
title: Plug-and-Play Parameter-Efficient Tuning of Embeddings for Federated Recommendation
motivation: Large item embeddings dominate FR parameters, causing communication bottleneck in distributed training
problem_framing: Apply PEFT techniques to item embeddings in federated recommendation to reduce transmitted parameter volume
key_insight: Freeze pre-trained full embeddings locally, only transmit lightweight compressed embeddings during training
method_signature: PEFT-based embedding framework combining frozen full embeddings with fine-tunable compressed embeddings
evaluation_criteria: Hit Ratio and NDCG at top-K; communication cost per client; differential privacy robustness
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: No single strategy consistently outperforms across all datasets and models; hash struggles on FedMF
evidence_for_taste: compressed embeddings typically suffer from poor robustness
overly large codebooks may introduce redundancy
even limited updates lead to noticeable performance improvements
performance does not consistently improve with larger k_L
thinking_moves: 把 embedding 压缩问题重新 frame 成 PEFT 调优问题
先用 warm-up 训练稳定优化过程
比较三类压缩策略的 representation collision 特性
通过 sensitivity analysis 探索超参与性能的 non-monotonic 关系
